speaker: rich
transcript: Mike, the man at the window was Dad. I saw his face. He came straight to the house and stood there looking in like he remembered it. I called to him, told him to come to the front door, but he just watched me, then turned back toward the trees. He looked sick—I know that—but he remembered this place. He has to still be in there somewhere. I’ve got four antigen cartridges, and one of them is for him. Watch the roads while I figure out how to bring him back without getting either of us killed.
summary: Rich tells Mike that Dad found the house and asks him to watch the roads while Rich plans a controlled return.
